description: Small source-checked excerpt locator benchmark. The excerpts below are real short quotations, not generated paper text. The agent assigned expected pages after inspecting the linked PDFs; these labels have not received independent human review.
limitations: Only 3 papers and 9 short excerpts: this is a locator smoke test, not a full-paper retrieval benchmark or a general recall estimate.
Page indexes are zero-based physical pages of the linked PDF edition. An excerpt's start/end within this fixture does not represent its position within the full PDF.
Questions and labels are curated by the implementing agent, so there is selection bias. No independent annotator agreement is claimed.
One relevant Chinese paraphrase deliberately exercises the known cross-language lexical-retrieval limitation; it must remain visible in the report even when missed.
No entire PDFs are redistributed. Each paper contributes no more than 25 quoted words; no permission to redistribute the complete papers is assumed.
